concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 0 – Research, Power Analysis & Data Verification
concerns.text: The implementation plan (plan.md) defines a Phase 0 for power analysis and data verification, but tasks.md contains no corresponding tasks (e.g., T‑xxx) that implement these activities. This leaves the plan element uncovered and the FR/SC validation pipeline without a concrete step to perform the required power analysis and checksum verification.
